note: Static audit rules. All are known classes from Bandit/Semgrep/CodeQL/CWE. Confirmation needs reading the data flow.

rules.title: TLS verification disabled
rules.impact: An attacker in the middle can hide a certificate error.
rules.fix: Enable verification or pin a CA.
rules.false_positive: Deliberate in a local test environment.

rules.title: Debug mode on in production
rules.impact: Stack traces, paths and variables leak. An interactive debugger can run code remotely.
rules.fix: Bind it to an environment variable and turn it off in production.
rules.false_positive: Harmless in a development settings file.

rules.title: CORS wildcard with credentials
rules.impact: Any origin can read session data.
rules.fix: Reflect the origin from an allowlist.
rules.false_positive: Browser behavior differs by version.

rules.title: Dynamic code execution
rules.impact: Code injection when input is unchecked.
rules.fix: Validate input or use a safe alternative.
rules.false_positive: Low risk with constant expressions.

rules.title: Unsafe deserialisation
rules.impact: Untrusted data can run code.
rules.fix: Use a safe loader, a signature or an allowlist.
rules.false_positive: Lower risk when only your own data is parsed.

rules.title: Command through a shell
rules.impact: Command injection when input reaches the shell.
rules.fix: Pass an argument list and turn the shell off.
rules.false_positive: Low risk with a fixed command.

rules.title: Query string concatenation
rules.impact: SQL injection when not parameterised.
rules.fix: Move to parameterised queries.
rules.false_positive: Safe when the driver sends parameters separately.

rules.title: Password in code
rules.impact: Direct login if it leaks.
rules.fix: Move it to an environment variable.
rules.false_positive: Placeholders and test values.

rules.title: Weak JWT signature validation
rules.impact: Tokens can be forged.
rules.fix: Pin the algorithm and reject none.
rules.false_positive: Lower impact for short lived tokens on an internal network.

rules.title: Weak randomness for tokens
rules.impact: Predictable tokens or passwords.
rules.fix: Use a CSPRNG.
rules.false_positive: Irrelevant for cosmetic values.

rules.title: Template injection candidate
rules.impact: Server side code runs when user input reaches the template.
rules.fix: Escape for the context or use a sandbox.
rules.false_positive: No risk with fixed templates.

rules.title: HTML sink
rules.impact: XSS when user data is not sanitized.
rules.fix: Sanitize or use textContent.
rules.false_positive: No risk with fixed content.

rules.title: postMessage target wildcard
rules.impact: The message goes to every origin.
rules.fix: Pin the target origin and validate the receiver.
rules.false_positive: Deliberate in public widgets.

rules.title: .env style key assignment
rules.impact: Every secret sits in the clone.
rules.fix: Remove it from the index and rotate values.
rules.false_positive: A .env.example with sample values is harmless.

rules.title: Docker latest tag
rules.impact: The version changes silently on the next pull.
rules.fix: Pin a version or a digest.
rules.false_positive: None.

rules.title: Privileged container
rules.impact: A container escape reaches the host.
rules.fix: Narrow the capabilities.
rules.false_positive: Some system containers need it.

rules.title: Container runs as root
rules.impact: A broken process is privileged on host files.
rules.fix: Switch to a low privilege user with USER.
rules.false_positive: Needed during first setup.

rules.title: pull_request_target workflow
rules.impact: Supply chain risk when PR code runs with secrets.
rules.fix: Narrow the permissions and pin the checkout ref.
rules.false_positive: No risk in workflows that only label.

rules.title: Unpinned GitHub Action
rules.impact: The code changes when the tag moves.
rules.fix: Pin the full commit SHA.
rules.false_positive: First party actions carry less risk.

rules.title: Remote script piped to a shell
rules.impact: The content can change during download.
rules.fix: Pin a version and verify a checksum.
rules.false_positive: None.

rules.title: Public S3 ACL
rules.impact: The bucket is open to all.
rules.fix: Limit it to the needed objects or use OAC.
rules.false_positive: A static site bucket can be public on purpose.

rules.title: Ingress open to the world
rules.impact: Every port, including admin, is exposed.
rules.fix: Narrow to known ranges.
rules.false_positive: Expected on a public load balancer.

rules.title: hostPath volume
rules.impact: The pod reaches the host filesystem.
rules.fix: Use a read-only, narrow path.
rules.false_positive: Node agents need it.

rules.title: Plain secret in Terraform
rules.impact: It sits in state and the repo.
rules.fix: Move it to a variable fed from a secret store.
rules.false_positive: A variable reference is not a real secret.

rules.title: chmod 777
rules.impact: Every user can write.
rules.fix: Use 755 or 750.
rules.false_positive: Sometimes needed for a shared temp directory.

rules.title: Errors swallowed silently
rules.impact: Failures go invisible and an empty result looks normal.
rules.fix: Log at minimum and catch narrow types.
rules.false_positive: Acceptable in cleanup code.

rules.title: No timeout on a network call
rules.impact: A slow service locks the process.
rules.fix: Set an explicit timeout.
rules.false_positive: The call may be wrapped in another layer.

rules.title: gets without a bound
rules.impact: A long line overflows the buffer.
rules.fix: Use fgets with sizeof.
rules.false_positive: A wrapper that checks the length.

rules.title: strcpy without a bound
rules.impact: The destination can overflow.
rules.fix: Use strncpy or snprintf and terminate.
rules.false_positive: The source length is proven bound.

rules.title: sprintf into a fixed buffer
rules.impact: A long formatted value overflows.
rules.fix: Use snprintf with the buffer size.
rules.false_positive: The buffer is sized above the maximum output.

rules.title: Shell execution
rules.impact: A shell or program call with tainted input can inject.
rules.fix: Pass a fixed program and quote or validate arguments.
rules.false_positive: A constant command with no input.

rules.title: SQL built by concatenation
rules.impact: A quote in the value changes the query.
rules.fix: Use PreparedStatement with parameters.
rules.false_positive: The value comes from a constant or a numeric cast.

rules.title: Request value written to the response
rules.impact: Script in the parameter runs in the browser.
rules.fix: Encode with an HTML encoder or a template engine.
rules.false_positive: The value is encoded earlier.

rules.title: MD5 used for hashing
rules.impact: MD5 collisions are cheap.
rules.fix: Use SHA-256 unless the format requires MD5.
rules.false_positive: A checksum for compatibility.

rules.title: Path built from request input
rules.impact: A crafted path can escape the directory.
rules.fix: Resolve the real path and check the prefix.
rules.false_positive: The input is an allowlisted name.

rules.title: URL built from request input
rules.impact: The server can be pointed at internal hosts.
rules.fix: Allowlist schemes and hosts, block link-local ranges.
rules.false_positive: A fixed upstream.

rules.title: Redirect target from request input
rules.impact: The link can send the user to another site.
rules.fix: Allowlist relative paths or known hosts.
rules.false_positive: The value is mapped to a fixed table.

rules.title: Cookie without the secure flag
rules.impact: The cookie can travel over plain HTTP.
rules.fix: Set Secure and HttpOnly, then SameSite.
rules.false_positive: A local development cookie.

rules.title: CSRF protection disabled
rules.impact: Cross-site requests are accepted.
rules.fix: Enable CSRF or use SameSite cookies with an origin check.
rules.false_positive: A stateless API with a bearer token only.

rules.title: Fixed IV or nonce
rules.impact: Reuse weakens the cipher mode.
rules.fix: Generate a random IV per message and store it with the ciphertext.
rules.false_positive: A test vector.

rules.title: CORS allows any origin
rules.impact: Any site can read the response.
rules.fix: List the origins, or keep the wildcard only for public data.
rules.false_positive: A public read-only API.
